one_liner: SendGrid Email API and marketing campaigns platform for sending and tracking emails at scale.
auth_notes: SendGrid uses API keys passed via headers for authentication.
access_notes: Users can sign up and start with a free trial/tier with limited daily credits.
api_notes: Comprehensive v3 REST APIs covering mail send, contacts, marketing campaigns, templates, stats, and suppressions.
blocker_notes: Public API with self-serve signup enables immediate building.

auth.quote: Make sure that an API key being used to make an API call is available via "settings > api keys", and that it has the proper permissions for the endpoint being requested.

access.quote: Beginning March 25, 2025 and when creating a new Twilio SendGrid account for email sending through either Twilio Console (then navigating to SendGrid) or directly with SendGrid, users will be given a 60 day timed free trial plan.

api.quote: The server uses SendGrid v3 APIs only. It never hardcodes API keys; provide SENDGRID_API_KEY

mcp.quote: An MCP stdio server for managing SendGrid email workflows from Codex and other MCP clients.

verdict.quote: Beginning March 25, 2025 and when creating a new Twilio SendGrid account for email sending through either Twilio Console (then navigating to SendGrid) or directly with SendGrid, users will be given a 60 day timed free trial plan.
